scope: F2 prepared scientific observation and its retained source anchor fields; both Nd prepared tuples with same field categories, plus scientific uptake/interpretation references
method: Independently read local source PDFs before inspecting target JSON; no prior source-task-check or paper-evaluation reports read. Text extraction plus full-page visual inspection. No input files edited.

status_definitions.supported: Source supports exported claim with its existing scope.
status_definitions.unsupported: Located source contradicts field or locator fails.
status_definitions.requires_qualification: Field is incomplete/ambiguous if interpreted without a stated limitation.
status_definitions.unassessable: Cannot establish from specified PDFs; not evidence of falsity.

items.source_evidence: Section 6, right column below Fig. 12: F2 can undergo an average maximum pore pressure of 55–57 MPa. Section 8 repeats maximum pore pressure of 55–57 MPa.
items.assessment: Exact author-reported summary, not a newly calculated interval.

items.exported_value: Maximum sustainable pore pressure, author-reported modeled summary
items.source_evidence: Section 5 defines maximum sustainable pore pressure Ppmax separately from the pore pressure increase required to cause failure. Table 3 F2: Ppi 22.04; Ppmax 57.4/57.3; ΔPp 35.4/35.3 MPa.
items.assessment: Correctly names absolute pore pressure; not increment and not an observed safe operating pressure.

items.exported_value: Modeled F2 fault reactivation during gas injection, Asmari reservoir
items.source_evidence: Methodology uses well logs to estimate stress; Section 5 plots Mohr diagrams; Section 8 estimates critical pore pressure due to gas injection for faults in Asmari reservoir.
items.assessment: Analytical/model estimate is faithful; no experimental validation claimed.

items.exported_value: F2; Asmari; Gachsaran SW Iran; zero cohesion; friction 0.6; three analytical methods
items.source_evidence: p.3: faults were considered cohesionless (C=0), friction can be set to 0.6 absent data; Table 1 p.4 F2 C=0, μ=0.6. p.11: principal stresses taken within a specified range (e.g. 10 m) of middle part of fault planes.
items.assessment: Listed conditions supported. C=0 and μ=0.6 are assumptions, not measured fault properties; modeled context preserves that meaning. Mid-fault sampling detail remains an important reuse limit.

items.exported_value: Recorded scope time=null; prepared field absent
items.source_evidence: Source describes current stress field and pore pressure, without a dated time-series observation attached to the 55–57 summary.
items.assessment: No numerical calendar time or injection duration can be established for this value; absence is not a contradiction.

items.exported_value: Author-reported modeled range; Table 4 separately lists formulation-specific Pc and PCr
items.source_evidence: Table 4 F2, equation 3/5: Pc=55.03/55.31 MPa; PCr=57.58/57.81 MPa. Narrative summary=55–57 MPa.
items.assessment: Faithful descriptive label. It must not become a confidence interval, measurement error, or exact min/max envelope: 57.81 exceeds 57.
